name: LookaCrawler
description: Free, open-source, token-efficient local crawler with a native MCP Server: strips >73% web bloat to clean Markdown, bypasses anti-bot via stealth Playwright, and exposes stdio/SSE transports.

steps: apt-get update && apt-get install -y unzip && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL=/tmp/bun bash && cp -r /tmp/bun/bin/* /usr/local/bin/
